{{Youmay|the Geonosian caste|the [[Yinchorri warrior caste|Yinchorri]] or [[Warrior caste|Yuuzhan Vong]] warrior castes}}
{{Otheruses|Warrior}}
[[File:Geonosian_ST.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A warrior caste regular]]
{{Quote|I'm sending my warriors to hide in the catacombs.|Geonosian [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]], to [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The '''warrior caste''' was lower station within the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] aristocracy. Members of the [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] caste were winged and divided into two sub-categories - the elite and the regulars. They matured quickly, achieving maturity at age six at which point they were battle-ready. The [[Geonosian Hive Army]] was consistuted of the warrior caste and dealt with internal struggles inside the hives, as well as to protect it from foreign threats.

==The regulars==
The regulars were bred for simple defense and security. They were equipped with simple [[Static pike/Legends|static pikes]] and [[Geonosian sonic blaster/Legends|sonic blasters]]. They wore no protective [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of any kind, instead relying on their hard exoskeleton, large numbers, and ability to fly to their advantage.

==The elite==
{{Main|Geonosian elite/Legends}}
[[File:GeoElite.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Geonosian elite]]
The elite [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] were often enhanced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] and given more powerful weaponry, such as [[Geonosian elite beam weapon|elite beam weapons]]. The elite also differed physically from regulars in that they had an extra pair of walking legs and longer abdomens, along with two large tusks/mandibles next to their [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Geonosian warrior caste first appeared in [[2002]] with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and its tie-ins.

The warriors appear in the 2002 [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''. They are the Confederacy of Independent Systems special units and are produced at Fortresses.
